C0766.title: Chengdu Police Dismantle Massive Real Estate and Home Decoration Data Leak, 56 Arrested
C0766.summary: In March 2026, Chengdu police uncovered a scheme involving the bulk online sale of residential community owner information. Investigation revealed that insiders He Mouchao and Ye from the real estate sector exploited their positions to steal vast amounts of data, which was then resold through intermediaries to downstream real estate agents and home decoration businesses.
